summary: A wheeled anti-air vehicle that launches homing missiles at both low drones and high-flying targets. It cannot shoot the ground, its two-missile salvo is wasted on cheap drones, and its reach is shorter than a Patriot battery's or a Su-34's glide bombs, so it guards a point or a column from close by.

sections.title: Anti-air missiles
sections.how: Select the Pantsir and left-click an enemy aircraft or missile, or let it fire at anything in range.
sections.body: Its turret launches homing missiles that track low drones and high-flying targets alike. Each shot is a two-missile salvo, so one target takes both missiles. It never fires at ground units or buildings, so it cannot defend itself against tanks or infantry. Its reach is shorter than a Patriot battery's and shorter than the Su-34's glide-bomb release, so it is a short-range guard rather than a long-range umbrella.

sections.title: Waves of cheap drones
sections.how: Watch it against a drone wave; no order is needed. It fires at the nearest valid target in range.
sections.body: Each salvo spends both missiles on one target. While it reloads, the next drone flies on, and a wave of cheap drones can soak its missiles and close the distance. It is strongest against a few valuable aircraft, not against a swarm; back it with quick-firing guns or riflemen.

sections.title: Move with the column
sections.how: Select the Pantsir and left-click the ground where it should go; on touch, tap.
sections.body: It is a wheeled vehicle, so it can follow an armoured push or shift to cover another building. Its armour is light: keep it behind the tanks and pull it back when enemy infantry or anti-tank teams get close.

sections.title: Repair at the vehicle factory
sections.how: Select the damaged Pantsir and press Repair at factory, or left-click your vehicle factory.
sections.body: The Pantsir drives to the factory and is repaired for half its price, paid as the health comes back. The factory repairs one vehicle at a time; production carries on while it waits its turn.

strong: High-flying aircraft and cruise missiles in range
Guarding a point from close range
weak: A Su-34 releasing glide bombs from outside its range
A Storm Shadow that slips inside its reduced engagement range
tips: Place it beside what Russia needs to protect: it engages only targets that come inside its missile range.
It cannot shoot the ground, so pair it with tanks or infantry that can protect it.
Do not chase a Patriot with it: the battery reaches farther and the Pantsir cannot shoot ground targets anyway.
A Su-34 releases its glide bombs from beyond the Pantsir's reach; use the Pantsir to cover the base, not to push a jet back.
Against a drone wave, add quick-firing guns or riflemen: each Pantsir salvo spends both missiles on one drone.
A Storm Shadow is hard to detect and is engaged only inside a third of the Pantsir's range; do not rely on one Pantsir to screen the whole base.
Pull a damaged Pantsir back to the vehicle factory; repairs cost half the price.
